NATO Phonetic Converter

Convert text to NATO phonetic alphabet words (Alpha, Bravo…) and parse phonetic words back to text.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter text in the input box.
  2. Choose Encode (text → NATO words) or Decode (NATO words → text).
  3. Press Convert to get the result.
  4. Copy the output with one click.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What characters are converted?

Letters A–Z, digits 0–9 (Zero, One, … Niner), spaces and common punctuation pass through unchanged.

Can I decode back to text?

Yes — decode matches each phonetic word case-insensitively (X-ray included). Unknown words are kept as-is in brackets.

Which digit words are used?

The digits follow the official NATO set: Zero, One, Two, Tree, Fower, Fife, Six, Seven, Ait, Niner.
